thread:
maria-pm: FinPulse dropped a SOC2 + retention questionnaire into the thread. Key asks: 7y audit log retention, per-tenant retention controls, and downloadable audit evidence for audits. They said this is contract-blocking; sales needs answers by next Friday. Link to their packet: https://drive.google.com/finpulse_qna (internal copy uploaded)
raj-sales: They just indicated they'll move to Dedicated if we can scope retention and evidence flows. Customer is legal/finance heavy — would rather get a clear outbound answer than a long back-and-forth. Can we give a timeline?
alex-sec: Short take: we can provide SOC2 artifact set (cert + control descriptions) immediately. 7y retention is a material increase vs our default 365d. Options:
- Offer per-tenant retention override, but gate it to Dedicated/Private only (security & cost isolation).
- Provide exportable audit bundles for e-discovery (signed CSV/Parquet + chain-of-custody meta).
- Or negotiate 1y default + contractual exception for FinPulse with addendum.
Here's a quick config sketch to discuss with infra/eng:
```json
{
  "retention_default_days": 365,
  "tenant_override_allowed": true,
  "max_retention_days": 2555  // ~7 years
}
```
tess-support: Support can run the evidence playbook but needs an agreed template and contact for retrievals. If we enable per-tenant retention, we should add a self-serve 'evidence export' workflow in Console so support isn't always the bottleneck.
oliver-legal: 7 years is common for finance. We'll need a data processing addendum and to validate with our DPA. Also confirm cross-border transfer implications for FinPulse (they have EU operations). I can draft the addendum once PM + Security confirm scope.
maria-pm: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
1) Product exposes a tenant-level retention override UI (Console) + API with guardrails (max 7y) and audit logs for changes.
2) Evidence export: downloadable, tamper-evident bundle (logs + metadata + manifest) for a requested date range.
3) Policy: retention overrides only available for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted customers default to 365d unless contractual exception approved by Legal.
4) Documentation + support playbook + checklist completed and reviewed by Security/Legal.
5) Delivery plan with cost estimate and rollout gating (canary, opt-in tenants).
raj-sales: Can we mark this P1 for FinPulse? They sign if we commit to a controlled plan and timeline. Sales needs a public-facing summary for the contract.
alex-sec: Recommend classification: P2 engineering (feature work) + P0 legal & SOC2 evidence delivery (we can hand them existing SOC2 artifacts now). Need infra estimate: at 7y retention for their expected log volume I estimate +1.2TB/month. Will add to the ticket.
maria-pm: Action items I/O:
- I'll open a scoped Jira (RDW-4867) with proposed ACs and cost stub.
- Oliver to draft addendum language (legal).
- Alex to produce infra cost estimate and security considerations.
- Tess to prepare support evidence playbook template.
- Raj to confirm FinPulse OK with gating to Dedicated/Private and schedule a scoping call.
triage-bot: Created issue RDW-4867: "FinPulse retention & evidence flow — scope negotiation" assigned to maria-pm.
raj-sales: Scoping call request — Wed 11am PT works for them. Can you confirm owners for the call? I'll invite FinPulse + their compliance lead.
maria-pm: I'll lead the call, alex-sec and oliver-legal on invite, tess-support for operational ask. I'll post the invite and attach the initial RDW ticket.
alex-sec: Quick note — if we do per-tenant retention we'll need KMS key lifecycle considerations for long-term keys and a retention-override audit event. Will add to RDW-4867.
maria-pm: Cool. Marking this thread resolved for now. Will update RDW-4867 after the scoping call. :white_check_mark:
raj-sales: Thanks everyone — will push timeline in FinPulse thread.
